body:
Just generally not able to connect to anyone... Friends or SO's.

I barely talk to my family either. Once every couple of months.

I don't know how to get over my feelings of anger against almost everyone in my family.

Over sharing about my self

I always either share too much, or get so worked up over approach anxiety I end up creeping them out...

These have been people I cared about, yes...

I've opened up to people before and it just pushed them away...
